checks.observation: Collector closed observation fields match actual router output. external_container_boundary contains manifest_sha256 and owner_uid/worker_uid; driver tags coding phase before collection.
Driver captures task CID/alias from independently verified admission before coding; collector requires the same scope and refuses missing scope.

Driver reaps worker UID, records exact cleanup return code and harvests receipts before collecting audits and writing report; helper refuses nonzero/missing/bool cleanup and incomplete session accounting.

Only descriptor-selected session filenames under owner protected parent are read; exact400 mode, same group, single regular link, no-follow and pre/post inode/metadata checks. Missing or mixed-validity sessions are unavailable, not partial/zero.

Closed bounded canonical audit JSON; all per-record/status/hash/count/budget checks precede aggregate. Export hashes/counts only, no raw requests, responses, code or private database. Prepared and delivered counters separated.

Factory reads only fully sealed bounded anonymous stdin; derives selected numerical receipt through native task-context loader, never caller-supplied owner artifact. Ordinary prompt is no-op, conflicting descriptor argv refused.

Kernel credentials plus original spawned-child PID birth/ancestry gate every read. Context identity and canonical+allocated source bytes checked around native owner pager; request cannot nominate receipt/database path.

Monitor registers spawned process and closes broker despite cleanup/guard errors; startup cleanup also retires guards. Broker captures file inode before writes; partial writes remove same inode. Close unlinks descriptor/socket and reports incomplete accounting if thread remains.
Opt-in numerical archive requires broker,client,router,deployment,collector,driver producer hashes. Always-used worker capability closure additionally pins broker/client for owner-entry import.

limitations: Session accounting is observer evidence and provides no proof, execution, completion or token-saving authority.
Broker close can truthfully record service_stopped=false if a native replay exceeds the bounded join; collector then refuses a complete count.
A missing final router receipt leaves selected-session accounting unavailable; collector does not infer zero or discover sessions by directory scan.
This review does not replace actual distinct-UID Docker validation or final source-bound regression gate.
